demo.title: based-seo-serp.sh
demo.code:
# 1. Discover endpoints (free, no auth)
curl https://based-seo.com/api/v3/manifest | jq '.endpoints[] | select(.slug|test("serp/google/organic"))'

# 2. Call + pay per request with an x402 wallet client (auto 402 -> pay -> retry)
#    body is an ARRAY of task objects; you are billed per task
curl -X POST https://based-seo.com/api/v3/serp/google/organic/live/advanced \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '[{"keyword":"best running shoes","location_code":2840,"language_code":"en"}]'
# -> HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to settle in USDC on Base

setup: Option A (no signup): pay per request with x402 - USDC on Base, no account or API key.
Fund an EVM wallet with USDC on Base and wrap fetch with an x402 client (e.g. `npm i x402-fetch`).
Discover endpoints + prices at https://based-seo.com/api/v3/manifest (OpenAPI at /openapi.json).
Call `POST https://based-seo.com/api/v3/{slug}`; on 402 retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
